title: NY State Assembly · District 53
area: North Brooklyn, including Bushwick and Williamsburg.

context.text: Uncontested race. Incumbent Maritza Davila (D), first elected in a 2013 special election, is running unopposed on the November 3, 2026 general-election ballot; no other candidate qualified for the Republican, Conservative or other party lines.

candidates.name: Maritza Davila

positions.summary: Sponsors A00989, which would add tenant protections against harassment or undue pressure in landlord buyout offers for rent-regulated apartments, requiring written disclosure of tenants' rights and penalizing harassment tactics.
positions.quote: Regulates buyout agreements within rent regulated apartments between a landlord and current tenant; provides penalties for harassment by a landlord.

record.text: Chairs the Assembly's Social Services Committee (since January 2023) and is a member of the Alcoholism and Drug Abuse, Children and Families, Housing and Rules committees in the 2025–2026 session; also a member of the Assembly's Puerto Rican/Hispanic Task Force.

Sponsors legislation on public assistance and rent-regulated housing, including A02502 (establishing home stability support supplement programs), A02538 (barring SNAP applicants from being required to submit to finger imaging) and A00989 (regulating buyout agreements within rent-regulated apartments); as of the current session these remained in committee without floor votes.

candidates.researchNotes: Davila has not completed a Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey and no 2026 campaign website with dated issue statements could be located; positions are left empty rather than inferred, and her record draws on her official Assembly biography, committee roles and legislative record.
